visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a white professional chef's jacket stands in front of a plain white wall. He has a focused and slightly panicked facial expression, leaning forward into a medium close-up shot. Animated blue sweat icons appear near his forehead alongside yellow and red text overlays. He brings his palms together in a prayer-like gesture while looking intensely at the camera. Large grey numeric digits from 5 down to 1 appear sequentially in the center of the frame against the background. (2) The man leans closer to the camera, his eyes wide and fixed on a point below the lens. He performs a rapid, vibrating hand movement mimicking high-speed keyboard typing. His facial expression is one of extreme concentration and urgency. The background remains the simple, indoor white wall with a television monitor partially visible in the distant back left corner. Red and yellow variety captions are prominent at the top of the frame. (3) The scene transitions to a setting with a white brick wall background. The man holds a large, rectangular purple product box featuring the text '2026 型男大主廚年菜' and images of various dishes. He smiles and gestures towards the box. The video then cuts to a rapid montage of close-up shots showing steaming soup in a ceramic pot, a braised pork hock in dark sauce, and a colorful seafood dish. The final frame is a graphic displaying eight different food bowls with text details on pricing and quantities.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks with intense focus and slight vocal strain, saying '準備好, 這次一定要搶到' followed by '好緊張.' Behind the voice, a steady, sharp mechanical ticking sound mimics a countdown clock, creating a rhythmic tension. There is no background music in this phase, leaving the acoustic space dominated by the dry vocal and the percussive ticking. (2) A sudden, high-density transient event occurs as the ticking stops and is replaced by the rapid 'clack-clack' of a simulated high-speed computer keyboard. The speaker lets out a sharp, high-pitched, high-arousal shout, '我搶到了!' characterized by strong vocal projection. Immediately following this, a second, female voice is heard asking '搶到了什麼?' with a slightly inquisitive and calmer tone. (3) Upbeat, energetic pop-electronic music with a driving synthesized beat and bright melodic textures begins. The main male speaker transitions into a high-energy promotional style, enunciating details about '型男大主廚' with a confident and loud vocal delivery. Throughout this phase, short 'ding' sound effects punctuate the audio to signal new information, while the upbeat BGM maintains a consistent energetic flow until the video ends.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Twist -> Product Details -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous 'bait-and-switch' narrative, first simulating the high-stress experience of grabbing concert tickets to grab attention, then revealing that the success is actually about purchasing a limited New Year food set. Its primary goal is to promote the '2026 型男大主廚年菜' by leveraging a relatable social scenario.
